class Base {
  value() { return 1; }
  static number() { return 2; }
  get count() { return 0; }
  set count(value: number) {}
}
class Derived extends Base {
  read() { return super["value"]().toUpperCase(); }
  missing() { return super["missing"]; }
  write() { super["count"] = "wrong"; }
  static wrong() { return super["number"]().toUpperCase(); }
}
